            ServerInfo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ServerInfo.Text = string.format("<b>Server #%d</b>\n👥 Players: %d/%d | 📶 Ping: %dms", idx, server.playing, server.maxPlayers, server.ping or 50)

            ServerInfo.TextColor3 = PALETTE.TEXT_MAIN

            ServerInfo.TextSize = 10
            ServerInfo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            ServerInfo.Parent = Card

            JoinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 28)
            JoinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.18, 0)
            JoinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (server.id == game.JobId) and PALETTE.NEON_GREEN or PALETTE.ACCENT

            end
        end
    end)
